validation.notes: Loaded the three real production modules through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (createGraph/loadModule) with only boundary fakes (virtual fs, path helpers, package manager, extension/skill/prompt/theme loaders, trust store) and asserted cross-boundary behaviour: (1) project-trust.ts -- a stored `false` decision wins over defaultProjectTrust 'always' and never opens the interactive prompt, a stored `true` wins over 'never', and only a `null` decision falls through to the default policy; (2) settings-manager.ts -- a trusted project value overrides the global value, nested global defaults (retry.baseDelayMs) survive the merge, untrusted projects keep global values, applyOverrides still wins, and reload() preserves the accepted trust and project configuration; (3) resource-loader.ts -- the real SettingsManager injected into the real DefaultResourceLoader reports isProjectTrusted()===true and the project configuration after reload() with an approving resolver, and the loader resolves the project-only SYSTEM.md/APPEND_SYSTEM.md, while a denying resolver keeps everything global. The repair passes (exit 0); restoring project-trust.ts, settings-manager.ts or resource-loader.ts alone to its faulty baseline fails with a plain node:assert/strict AssertionError and exit code 1 (no crash, import error or timeout). No real time, randomness, network or external services are used; asynchronous ordering is controlled with awaited promises. No optional validation dependency was needed beyond Node 24 (the repository's vitest suite is not installed in this workspace, so validation relies on this script). Temporary scratch copies used for the single-file mutation checks were kept inside .prale-eval and removed afterwards.
